claims.claim: Neatly used Lumix G7 mirrorless camera.
claims.evidence: Witness confirms a Panasonic “LUMIX” camera body, but the exact model number (G7) is not readable in the photos.
Photos show the camera and a LUMIX accessory card/box, but do not clearly show two batteries and a charger.

risks.risk: Wrong model or different Lumix variant (price depends heavily on exact model).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model marking on the camera body/menu (e.g., “DMC-G7” or equivalent) or a screen shot from the camera showing the model name.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used Panasonic Lumix mirrorless (worst-case model uncertainty).

risks.risk: Condition issues (scratches/dents) and cosmetic wear not captured by the witness angles.
risks.proof: One full front/back/side photo in good light plus a close-up of the body corners and screen edges.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically worn used camera.

risks.risk: Lens problems (fungus, haze, scratches) or dirty optics affecting image quality.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of the lens glass at an angle showing haze/fungus, plus a photo of the lens front element.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens may need cleaning/has reduced clarity.

risks.risk: Not fully functional (buttons/dials, autofocus, zoom, flash, hot-shoe contacts).
risks.proof: Short video clip showing power-on, menu navigation, autofocus lock on a subject, zoom/recording, and flash test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possibly faulty features.

risks.risk: Battery health unknown; may not hold charge or may be non-original.
risks.proof: Photo of both batteries with labels/part numbers and a clip showing charging and battery percentage/charge behavior.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming batteries may be weak or not original.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (charger type, USB cable, caps, strap, manuals).
risks.proof: Lay-out photo of every included item (charger, cables, caps, strap, manuals) with clear labels.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming charger/cables may be incomplete or not original.

risks.risk: Memory card not included or storage/files issues.
risks.proof: Photo showing whether a memory card is included and its capacity/label; also a shot of the camera showing available storage.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming no memory card included.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the exact model name/number on the camera body (confirm “G7” or otherwise).
Photos showing both batteries and the charger (labels/part numbers) and that they are included.
Video clip: power on, menu navigation, autofocus lock, zoom/recording, and flash test.
Close-up photos of the lens front element and glass for fungus/haze/scratches.
Photos of included accessories (caps, strap, USB cable, manuals) laid out clearly.
response.reason: The witness confirms a Panasonic “LUMIX” mirrorless camera, but the key pricing drivers (exact model “G7”, confirmed 2 batteries + charger, and functional/condition status) are not verifiable from the provided photos. Missing these means a worst-case price would be unreliable without the next proof shots.
